annotations.title: Name the people the book is waiting on, with an address where there is one.

description: Records who is expected to record. A person with an email address can be emailed the invitation and the reminders; a person with only a name is reached in a group chat, and the reminder message names them. Adding a person sends nothing.

people.description: The people, each as a name, or as a name and an email address. A name on its own is somebody reached in a group chat.
